findings.message: external data source src names its credential by AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_SECRET_NAME and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET_NAME, a deprecated secret object whose value the database administrator reads in clear from .metadata/secrets; on YDB 25.4 and later, keep the value in a YDB secret and name it by AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID_SECRET_PATH and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY_SECRET_PATH
